reel2.caption:
Every runner has told at least three of these this month.
The easy 5k that wasn't, the race you weren't racing, the stretch you'll do later.
Which race are you training for? Tell me below.

#runningmemes #runnerproblems #runningcommunity #trailrunningsa #PaceShark

slides.sub: Nobody tells you these. Until now.

slides.title: Stay level
slides.head: No half-wheeling: stay level with the pacer.
slides.body: Creeping ahead turns an easy run into a race nobody signed up for.

slides.title: Two abreast, max
slides.head: Chat side by side, not five across the road.
slides.body: Single file when cars come. Everyone gets home, the club keeps its good name.

slides.title: Regroup at turns
slides.head: Fast runners loop back. Nobody runs alone.
slides.body: The best clubs wait at the corners so the back of the bunch never gets lost.

slides.title: Lights on
slides.head: Headlamp, reflective kit, blinking light.
slides.body: Early starts and winter evenings: if drivers can't see you, they can't miss you.

slides.title: Say if you cut it
slides.head: Turning back early? Tell someone first.
slides.body: Otherwise half the club goes looking for you at the finish.

slides.title: Easy means easy
slides.head: Save the heroics for the Tuesday session.
slides.body: The recovery run is not the place to prove your fitness.

slides.sub: They will know who it is for.
